full_translation: Today is an auspicious day of sublime merit for the festival of the Lord Buddha. We hoist the long golden Buddhist banner high up the sacred ceremonial monastery pole. As the colorful banner flutters in the morning mountain breeze, it proclaims the Dhamma to all four directions. The monastic Sangha chants protective Parittas while elders bow their heads in silent devotion. May all beings across the world dwell in enduring tranquility, free from affliction and sorrow.
